versions.changelog:
- Renamed from "testing-workflow" to "tester-workflow" throughout the documentation and file structure.
- Renamed main metadata file from "skill.md" to "SKILL.md".
- Updated all file paths, examples, and documentation to reflect the new naming.

Initial release of the "testing-workflow" skill with end-to-end testing process.

- Provides a comprehensive, modular workflow for testing: from requirements analysis and design understanding to test case generation and review.
- Includes four integrated sub-skills: analyze-requirements, understand-design, generate-test-cases, and review-test-cases—each available for independent use.
- Offers detailed, step-by-step documentation and templates for each workflow phase with strict professional standards.
- Supports different usage scenarios: full process, test-case generation only, or test-case review only.
- All instructions, principles, and process diagrams are included for clarity and quick onboarding.
